description: The City and County of Denver publishes sanitary sewer-main lines through Wastewater Management. The schema includes upstream and downstream node identifiers, elevations, slope, diameter and vertical size in inches, material, lining information, ownership, installation date, lifecycle status and sanitary-basin fields. These network and asset descriptions can supply inputs for wastewater-flow research when checked against suitable boundary conditions. Field availability does not establish populated values, correct connectivity or current pipe condition. No hydraulic model was run and no feature values were obtained. The provider labels this information as not for engineering purposes and disclaims accuracy and completeness. The observation period and completeness of the published network remain unverified. Coverage is limited to the provider-described county infrastructure. Public catalogue and layer metadata are free to access. The catalogue supplies provider use constraints. ArcGIS layer metadata and the landing page returned HTTP 200. Export bodies and feature rows were not downloaded; distribution usability remains unverified. Related records cover other infrastructure layers in this county catalogue.
